words.meaning: Blood relationship or a sharing of characteristics or origins.
words.sentence1: They felt an immediate kinship the moment they started talking about art. (They felt an immediate kinship the moment they started talking about art.)
words.sentence2: A deep sense of kinship united the members of the community. (A deep sense of kinship united the members of the community.)

words.meaning: A relation of friendship, community of interests, and mutual companionship.
words.sentence1: El compañerismo en el equipo es fundamental para ganar el torneo. (The camaraderie in the team is essential to win the tournament.)
words.sentence2: Demostraron un gran compañerismo durante los momentos difíciles. (They showed great companionship during the difficult times.)

words.meaning: Familiarity, acquaintance, or close connection between people.
words.sentence1: Il a noué une accointance discrète avec ses nouveaux voisins. (He formed a discreet acquaintance with his new neighbors.)
words.sentence2: Leur vieille accointance facilitait les affaires entre eux. (Their old connection made business easier between them.)

words.meaning: An affinity or close relationship between people chosen by mutual preference.
words.sentence1: Zwischen den beiden Künstlern bestand eine echte Wahlverwandtschaft. (There was a genuine elective affinity between the two artists.)
words.sentence2: Manchmal ist eine Wahlverwandtschaft stärker als familiäre Bande. (Sometimes an elective affinity is stronger than family ties.)

words.meaning: A close friend, companion, or member of an intimate group who share a common bond.
words.sentence1: Karera wa donna toki mo tasukeau daiji na nakama desu. (They are precious companions who help each other no matter what.)
words.sentence2: Watashi wa kono shigoto de subarashii nakama ni deatta. (I met wonderful comrades through this work.)

words.meaning: Deep harmony, mutual understanding, and rapport between people.
words.sentence1: Il loro grande affiatamento si nota subito quando suonano insieme. (Their great harmony is immediately noticeable when they play together.)
words.sentence2: C'è un perfetto affiatamento tra i membri del gruppo di ricerca. (There is a perfect rapport among the members of the research group.)

words.meaning: Deep emotional resonance and heartfelt connection between kindred spirits.
words.sentence1: Tāmen liǎng rén jīngcháng zài yinyue zhōng zhǎodào gānxīn de gǎnjué. (The two of them often find a sense of heartfelt connection through music.)
words.sentence2: Zhèyàng de gānxīn zài xiànjīn de shèhuì lǐ fēicháng nán de. (This kind of deep connection is very rare in modern society.)

words.meaning: A circle of companionship or an intimate gathering of close associates.
words.sentence1: Uri neun maeil jeonyeok dongan eul ieoganda. (We continue our circle of companionship every evening.)
words.sentence2: Geu dongan ui modeun wonsong i seororeul akkimyeo jinaetda. (All members of that fellowship cherished one another.)

words.meaning: Association, communion, or fellowship based on mutual trust and friendship.
words.sentence1: Puokkea ban bangkeut samacheap muoy daermpi chuoyampelknea. (They formed a fellowship to help one another.)
words.sentence2: Samacheap nei knuong kromruon nuh laor nas. (The fellowship within that group is very good.)

words.meaning: Brotherhood, a close bond of fellowship and solidarity.
words.sentence1: Die broederskap tussen die manskappe was onbreekbaar. (The brotherhood among the crew members was unbreakable.)
words.sentence2: Hulle het ’n diep sin vir broederskap in die gemeenskap gebou. (They built a deep sense of fellowship in the community.)
